scope: Using only the canonical F portable shared runner, select up to 20 source-verified rows lacking downloaded evidence, download up to two real listing images per row, render the canonical parcel polygon, write a row-level evidence manifest and update the 8012 website JSON after every processed row.
runtime_selection: source-verified rows without downloaded_photo_paths, sorted by row_id
acceptance: Only images downloaded from the real listing page may be recorded as evidence.
Every processed row must expose downloaded_photo_paths, polygon_render_path, vision_output_path, batch_id, evidence_updated_at, status_json_path and report_md_path on the website.
The website JSON and active batch JSON must update after every row so progress is visible after refresh.
No visual_match_score, VISION_COMPARED status or 3.5+ confidence may be written; real vision comparison remains a separate required step.
Git work commit and remote branch readback must be recorded.
Do not create or request another runner.
